title: ADAEZE'S THREE NOES
deck: A ministry has twelve days to hold a failing hillside above a hospital, but Adaeze refuses its single elegant system three times—for the graves it would move, the dependency it would create, and the local design it would erase.
shape: Regional institutional crisis in six scenes: three refusals become three engineering requirements, a hostile groundwater test survives a contested local memory, an audited interface standard lets three independently governed modules share one drainage spine, and a storm breaks one seam safely; Adaeze, the districts, the hospital and the ministry each retain a veto.

scenes.title: Three Noes
paragraphs: *Aruwa regional hall, hillside map room · Day 1, 08:10*

The hillside above St. Orra Hospital had moved eleven centimetres in six days. On the ministry map it was one red crescent. On the ground it was three districts, four thousand homes, a school, a market and a burial field older than the road that divided it. The first heavy rain was due in twelve days.

Ministerial engineers had drawn one answer in blue: a continuous retaining curtain, forty-two load-field plates linked through a private control room, and a diversion channel cut straight across the slope. Every plate shared the load; if one failed, the others would carry it.
Illuminara's mother Adaeze sat with the three district chairs. She listened until the procurement director asked for assent.

**Adaeze**  
No.

**Director Miro Venn**  
Mrs. Okafor, the graves can be reinterred with ceremony. Compensation is included.

**Adaeze**  
Kiru's dead are not a line item to be lifted because your blue line is straight.
Venn turned a page. The control room would belong for twenty-five years to Cadran Systems, whose plates the ministry could procure in time.

**Adaeze**  
No.
Belu would not put the ground beneath its houses behind a company's password and call that safety.

The drainage appendix cut across a stone trench Sava residents had built by hand after the last wet season. Chief Engineer Lio Mensah called it unlined, irregular and too small for the design storm. He was right about its size.

**Adaeze**  
No. They measured every seep for seven years. Your survey calls their work an obstruction because it began after they finished.

**Illuminara**  
Are those three refusals, or three requirements the plan has failed to meet?

**Director Miro Venn**  
They have the same effect. We lose the only package that can clear audit this week.
Illuminara closed the blue projection before its elegance became an argument by repetition.

**Illuminara**  
Give me the residents' measurements, the hospital's water records and twenty-one hours. If the trench is local drainage, your curtain remains fastest. If it is carrying the hill, we have called the spine an obstacle.

scenes.title: The Fourth Line
paragraphs: *Sava district, contour trench · Day 1, 09:30*

The trench was knee-deep, faced with mismatched stone and bent around breadfruit roots. Adaeze walked it with Kemi Sol, the mason who had marked the first seep, while Mensah's team set nine piezometers above and below it.

**Kemi Sol**  
It fills beneath the red house, then here, then at the school bend. Never the other way around.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
Depth is not source. A leaking hospital main could give you the same order.

**Illuminara**  
Then we test both causes. Treated water carries chloride. Hillside seepage carries iron from the upper basalt.
On a stone she wrote two rival explanations and what each must predict at all nine wells.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
And if neither survives?

**Illuminara**  
The fourth line is 'we do not know,' and three districts do not build on it.

At 10:06 the three Kiru heads rose in order. Eight minutes later the wet line climbed one stone course beneath the red house, then another beside the sixth well. The school-bend head stayed flat while the masonry between it and the sixth well darkened. When Kemi opened the trench, the upstream heads and the wet courses fell in the same order.

Illuminara chalked the times onto the wall. The missing quantity was water, not load, and it left the measured path somewhere between the sixth well and the bend. That interval ran under the Belu laundry.

Kemi opened seven notebooks, each wet season in a different colour. The hospital main had been closed twice; the red-house-to-school sequence had continued. Each pressure rise also preceded the nearest slope marker's movement by roughly ninety minutes.

**Kemi Sol**  
Officials ask whether it is big enough. Nobody asks why it is here.

**Illuminara**  
Three groundwater paths meet here. The throat is too narrow, but the collector is real. Drain the hill first; retain what remains.
The throat could not widen toward Kiru without approaching the graves. Illuminara pointed toward the road.

**Illuminara**  
Now we find whether it can deepen the other way.

scenes.title: Twenty-One Hours
paragraphs: *Aruwa hillside and St. Orra plant room · Day 1, 11:00 to Day 2, 05:00*

The hospital isolated its upper main. No well showed its chloride trace; iron rose in a fan from the basalt. Mensah abandoned the leaking-main explanation, but not his objection to making a regional spine from a village trench.

At noon Kemi released a measured tracer above Kiru. The middle wells should answer in order and the school bend last. If water scattered or bypassed the trench, the interface idea would fail before anyone signed it.
Two middle wells answered. The Belu well did not.

**Director Miro Venn**  
One silent well is enough. Three contractors will blame one another while the hospital slides.
Illuminara followed the groundwater interval she had chalked to the laundry floor. Adaeze looked at the old drain scar and remembered a cistern there, used during a nurses' strike.

**Kemi Sol**  
Its clay pipe was sealed before I took the trench.

**Adaeze**  
My mother drew water from its overflow after that.

They opened the laundry floor and found the cistern full, its pipe hidden below the well. Before a sensor was moved, Mensah wrote the branch test: the overflow must answer first, a temporary probe below the pipe must answer next, the silent well must stay flat and the school bend must rise last. If the bend rose before the probe, or chloride appeared, the branch was false.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
I accept no cistern until all four lines hold.
At 23:30 the overflow answered. The lower probe followed at 00:30; the Belu well stayed flat. At 02:00 the school bend rose last. Mensah signed beneath the prediction, then beneath his acceptance.
A road-side shaft found basalt falling away soon enough for a covered culvert twice the trench's measured peak. Proof loading left sixteen percent spare capacity after wet bedding settlement.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
The residents found the collector. They did not size the throat.

**Kemi Sol**  
We had hammers, not your drill rig.

**Illuminara**  
Both facts belong in the design. The trench is the spine. The culvert is its new throat. Retaining work must meet it without owning it.
By dawn the first and third noes no longer opposed each other. The second still did.

scenes.title: One Package
paragraphs: *Ministry audit chamber · Day 2, 09:00*
Venn gave them ninety minutes. Emergency law released money for one package, one accountable integrator and one acceptance test.

**Director Miro Venn**  
I am defending a signature I can prosecute if the hospital is buried. Give me one throat to hold.

**Adaeze**  
The districts refuse to become tenants of the remedy, not accountability.

Illuminara placed four pages on the table. They specified interfaces, not a wall: pressure delivered to the common spine, anchor exclusions around the graves, open sensors, manual safe states, public keys and joint inspection at every seam.

**Illuminara**  
Buy one audited interface. Let three districts choose three compliant modules. The integrator owns the seams and the test, not their controls.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
Where did you get eight percent?
Illuminara laid the road-throat proof sheet beside the settlement trace. Sixteen percent was the measured reserve after the bad bedding had taken its share.

**Illuminara**  
No seam may consume more than half the smallest passive reserve. The link pin is rated to creep under transfer above eight percent and part after ten sustained minutes. That endurance is in the metal, not a command. The drainage spine stays open when it separates.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
Then an inspector at any seam gets stop-work authority. Not a dashboard. A person.

**Director Miro Venn**  
And every fault and override is public before the next shift. Liability cannot live in three private notebooks.
Illuminara crossed out two clauses and wrote both changes into the standard.

**Illuminara**  
Agreed. They need not think as one system. They must fail without making a neighbour fail.
Hospital director Nia Sorel read the endurance clause twice.

**Nia Sorel**  
Can this be inspected before the rain?

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
If excavation begins today and choices freeze by sunset.

The districts chose: Kiru's stone buttress outside the graves; Belu's public plates with local keys, operated by Sami Daro, who would hold the district's physical key; Sava's terraced anchors tied to the trench. Kemi's crew would supervise every old connection.
Adaeze signed beneath the three requirements and accepted the seam chair only until the rain. Venn signed last. One package went to tender at 10:27. It contained no single wall.

scenes.title: The Seams
paragraphs: *Aruwa hillside · Days 2 to 11*

The road culvert went in first. Illuminara held the exposed load path while the crew seated the second arch. She released it after thirty-eight minutes, before mortar could lock a hidden dependence into the joint; the arch had to show it could carry itself. Mensah stopped work when the first bedding layer crossed its settlement limit. Kemi's crew rebuilt it.

Kiru curved its buttress around the burial field. Belu installed twelve public plates on ferrite ribs, each with a physical key. Sava drove terraced anchors and fitted removable gates where every terrace met the old trench.

Every seam needed three signatures: ministry inspector, district operator and a neighbouring crew. During the sixth-plate test Kemi closed the lower drain gate. The transfer needle climbed past eight and stopped at eleven percent toward Kiru.

**Chief Engineer Lio Mensah**  
The plate passes its own specification. The seam fails.

**Sami Daro**  
Hold the gate there. Change the angle, not the reading.

Sami reset the plate by two degrees. Kiru's masons laid a sacrificial slip course while Kemi reopened the gate one notch at a time. The needle fell to six percent and decayed in seven minutes. All three crews signed the fault before they signed the repair.
On Day 9 Cadran offered a storm monitor with no control channel.

**Adaeze**  
Can the districts turn it off?

**Sami Daro**  
At our office. Raw records remain ours.

**Adaeze**  
Then it may watch. It may not become the memory we cannot afford to lose.

By Day 11 the culvert carried twice the old peak, every log was public at the hospital and each module passed dry load. Adaeze refused the ministry's photograph until Kemi and all three operators stood in it.

scenes.title: Rain
paragraphs: *St. Orra Hospital and Aruwa hillside · Day 12, 03:20 to 18:40*

Rain arrived three hours early and harder than forecast. The piezometers rose; ninety minutes later the slope markers answered. Water entered the Sava trench at the red house and struck the road culvert in a brown sheet. The throat held.

At 06:40 Kiru's seam alarm showed nine percent toward Belu. Sami Daro reduced plate six and Kemi delayed gate four until the pressure peak. The transfer stayed above the eight-percent cap. Ten sustained minutes exhausted the pin's rated endurance.

The passive link broke with a sound like a snapped spade handle. Belu separated from Kiru exactly as the standard required. Kiru's buttress carried alone, its sacrificial slip course grinding five millimetres.
The eastern Kiru marker began to move: one millimetre, then two. Nia Sorel's voice came through the hospital channel.

**Nia Sorel**  
Paediatrics is ready to clear. Tell me whether the rate is still rising.

**Kemi Sol**  
The marker slowed when gate four opened. It is still at two millimetres.

**Nia Sorel**  
Then paediatrics stays. I will clear the wing if the third reading rises.
Venn heard the ministry lawyer ask who would own an evacuation if the third reading rose.

**Director Miro Venn, on the radio**  
Cadran can take the plates now. I can put one operator under the liability.

**Sami Daro**  
Then put my name under the local key. Belu stands alone.
He turned the key to safe angle. Kemi watched the white stone disappear beneath the trench.

**Kemi Sol**  
Gate four open. Terrace closed to the trench. Send it all to the culvert.

The third marker reading held at two millimetres, then fell. For fourteen minutes the districts carried separate loads while the culvert took their common water. Sami reset the plate at four percent. The broken pin could not be replaced before the rain ended, so the modules remained apart and joint inspections doubled.
Illuminara held the radio but gave no order.

At 18:40 the hospital remained open, nobody had evacuated, and no slope marker had moved more than four millimetres. Kiru's slip course was damaged, the pin was gone and shared reserve would stay unavailable until both were replaced.
Venn published the standard with the tracer test, the rejected bedding, the storm separation and the fault ledger attached.

**Adaeze**  
Three noes did not become a yes.

**Illuminara**  
No. They became the shape of what could be built.

Adaeze touched her daughter Illuminara's cheek, then went uphill to chair the inspection. At the school bend, Kemi painted the high-water mark beside seven years of colours. The new line was the darkest and the lowest.

critic_line: A ministry's one elegant system is refused three times, and each refusal becomes an engineering requirement - a village trench read as the hill's real drain, a standard with a pin built to break, a key left in a district's hand - so a hospital stays open on a moving hill without a grave moved or a neighbour dragged down.

translation_sl.title: ADAEZEJINI TRIJE NE-JI
translation_sl.deck: Ministrstvo ima dvanajst dni, da zadrži popuščajoče pobočje nad bolnišnico, toda Adaeze trikrat zavrne njegov en sam eleganten sistem — zaradi grobov, ki bi jih premaknil, odvisnosti, ki bi jo ustvaril, in lokalne zasnove, ki bi jo izbrisal.
translation_sl.shape: Regionalna institucionalna kriza v šestih prizorih: tri zavrnitve postanejo tri inženirske zahteve, sovražen preizkus podtalnice potrdi sporen krajevni spomin, revidiran standard vmesnikov trem neodvisno upravljanim modulom omogoči skupno uporabo ene drenažne hrbtenice, neurje pa varno prelomi en spoj; Adaeze, okrožja, bolnišnica in ministrstvo vsak obdržijo pravico veta.

scenes.title: Trije ne-ji
paragraphs: *Regionalna dvorana Aruwa, soba z zemljevidi pobočja · 1. dan, 08:10*

Pobočje nad bolnišnico St. Orra se je v šestih dneh premaknilo za enajst centimetrov. Na ministrskem zemljevidu je bilo en sam rdeč polmesec. Na terenu so bila tri okrožja, štiri tisoč domov, šola, tržnica in pokopališče, starejše od ceste, ki ga je razdelila. Prvo močno deževje naj bi prišlo čez dvanajst dni.

Ministrski inženirji so z modro narisali eno rešitev: neprekinjeno podporno pregrado, dvainštirideset plošč za razporeditev obremenitve, povezanih prek zasebne nadzorne sobe, in preusmeritveni kanal, vrezan naravnost čez pobočje. Vse plošče bi si delile obremenitev; če bi ena odpovedala, bi jo prevzele druge.
Illuminarina mati Adaeze je sedela s predsedniki treh okrožij. Poslušala je, dokler direktor za nabavo ni zaprosil za soglasje.

**Adaeze**  
Ne.

**Direktor Miro Venn**  
Gospa Okafor, posmrtne ostanke je mogoče slovesno prenesti. Odškodnina je vključena.

**Adaeze**  
Kirujski mrtvi niso postavka, ki jo lahko prestavite samo zato, ker je vaša modra črta ravna.
Venn je obrnil stran. Nadzorna soba bi za petindvajset let pripadla družbi Cadran Systems, katere plošče bi ministrstvo lahko pravočasno nabavilo.

**Adaeze**  
Ne.
Belu varnosti tal pod svojimi hišami ne bo skril za geslo podjetja in tega imenoval varnost.

Dodatek o odvodnjavanju je sekal kamnit jarek, ki so ga prebivalci Save ročno zgradili po zadnji mokri sezoni. Glavni inženir Lio Mensah ga je označil za neobloženega, nepravilnega in premajhnega za načrtovano neurje. Glede velikosti je imel prav.

**Adaeze**  
Ne. Sedem let so merili vsak izvir. Vaša raziskava njihovo delo imenuje ovira, ker se je začela po tem, ko so ga dokončali.

**Illuminara**  
So to tri zavrnitve ali tri zahteve, ki jih načrt ni izpolnil?

**Direktor Miro Venn**  
Učinek je enak. Izgubili bomo edini paket, ki lahko ta teden prestane revizijo.
Illuminara je zaprla modro projekcijo, preden je njena eleganca s ponavljanjem postala argument.

**Illuminara**  
Dajte mi meritve prebivalcev, bolnišnične podatke o vodi in enaindvajset ur. Če je jarek krajevni odtok, ostaja vaša pregrada najhitrejša rešitev. Če odvaja pobočje, smo hrbtenico razglasili za oviro.

scenes.title: Četrta vrstica
paragraphs: *Okrožje Sava, jarek po plastnici · 1. dan, 09:30*

Jarek je segal do kolen, bil obložen z neusklajenim kamenjem in zavit okoli korenin kruhovca. Adaeze je po njem hodila s Kemi Sol, zidarko, ki je označila prvi izvir, medtem ko je Mensahova ekipa nad njim in pod njim postavila devet piezometrov.

**Kemi Sol**  
Napolni se pod rdečo hišo, nato tukaj in potem pri šolskem ovinku. Nikoli v nasprotni smeri.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Globina ni izvor. Puščajoči bolnišnični vod bi lahko ustvaril isto zaporedje.

**Illuminara**  
Potem preizkusimo oba vzroka. Obdelana voda vsebuje klorid. Voda iz pobočja vsebuje železo iz zgornjega bazalta.
Na kamen je zapisala dve tekmujoči razlagi in napoved, ki jo mora vsaka izpolniti pri vseh devetih vrtinah.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Kaj pa, če ne preživi nobena?

**Illuminara**  
Četrta vrstica se glasi »ne vemo« in tri okrožja ne bodo gradila na njej.

Ob 10:06 so se tri kirujske gladine dvignile po vrsti. Osem minut pozneje se je mokra črta pod rdečo hišo dvignila za eno kamnito vrsto, nato še ob šesti vrtini. Gladina pri šolskem ovinku je ostala nespremenjena, medtem ko je zid med njim in šesto vrtino potemnel. Ko je Kemi odprla jarek, so se zgornje gladine in mokre vrste znižale v istem zaporedju.

Illuminara je čase s kredo zapisala na zid. Manjkajoča količina je bila voda, ne obremenitev, in iz merjene poti je izginila nekje med šesto vrtino in ovinkom. Ta odsek je potekal pod belujsko pralnico.

Kemi je odprla sedem zvezkov, za vsako mokro sezono druge barve. Bolnišnični vod je bil dvakrat zaprt; zaporedje od rdeče hiše do šole se je nadaljevalo. Vsak dvig tlaka je tudi za približno devetdeset minut prehitel premik najbližjega označevalca pobočja.

**Kemi Sol**  
Uradniki sprašujejo, ali je dovolj velik. Nihče ne vpraša, zakaj je tukaj.

**Illuminara**  
Tu se stikajo tri poti podtalnice. Grlo je preozko, zbiralnik pa je resničen. Najprej odvedimo vodo s pobočja; nato podprimo, kar ostane.
Grla proti Kiruju ni bilo mogoče razširiti, ne da bi se približali grobovom. Illuminara je pokazala proti cesti.

**Illuminara**  
Zdaj ugotovimo, ali ga lahko poglobimo v drugo smer.

scenes.title: Enaindvajset ur
paragraphs: *Pobočje Aruwa in strojnica bolnišnice St. Orra · 1. dan, 11:00 do 2. dan, 05:00*

Bolnišnica je ločila zgornji vod. Nobena vrtina ni pokazala njegove kloridne sledi; železo se je pahljačasto širilo iz bazalta. Mensah je opustil razlago o puščajočem vodu, ne pa tudi ugovora, da bi regionalno hrbtenico naredili iz vaškega jarka.

Opoldne je Kemi nad Kirujem spustila odmerjeni sledilnik. Srednje vrtine bi se morale odzvati po vrsti, šolski ovinek pa zadnji. Če bi se voda razpršila ali obšla jarek, bi zamisel o vmesnikih propadla, še preden bi jo kdo podpisal.
Dve srednji vrtini sta se odzvali. Belujska vrtina se ni.

**Direktor Miro Venn**  
Ena nema vrtina je dovolj. Trije izvajalci bodo krivili drug drugega, medtem ko bo bolnišnica drsela.

Illuminara je sledila odseku podtalnice, ki ga je označila s kredo, do tal pralnice. Adaeze je pogledala staro brazgotino odtoka in se spomnila, da je tam nekoč stal zbiralnik, ki so ga uporabljali med stavko medicinskih sester.

**Kemi Sol**  
Njegova glinena cev je bila zatesnjena, preden sem prevzela jarek.

**Adaeze**  
Moja mati je po tem črpala vodo iz njegovega preliva.

Odprli so tla pralnice in našli poln zbiralnik, njegova cev pa je bila skrita pod vrtino. Preden so premaknili en sam senzor, je Mensah zapisal preizkus veje: najprej se mora odzvati preliv, nato začasna sonda pod cevjo, nema vrtina mora ostati nespremenjena, šolski ovinek pa se mora dvigniti zadnji. Če bi se ovinek dvignil pred sondo ali bi se pojavil klorid, bi bila veja napačna.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Zbiralnika ne sprejmem, dokler ne držijo vse štiri vrstice.

Ob 23:30 se je odzval preliv. Spodnja sonda mu je sledila ob 00:30; belujska vrtina je ostala nespremenjena. Ob 02:00 se je zadnji dvignil šolski ovinek. Mensah se je podpisal pod napoved in nato pod sprejetje.

Obcestni jašek je razkril, da bazalt dovolj zgodaj pada, da je mogoče vgraditi pokrit prepust z dvakratnikom izmerjenega največjega pretoka jarka. Po poskusni obremenitvi je po posedanju mokre podlage ostalo šestnajst odstotkov rezerve.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Prebivalci so našli zbiralnik. Niso dimenzionirali grla.

**Kemi Sol**  
Imeli smo kladiva, ne vašega vrtalnega stroja.

**Illuminara**  
Obe dejstvi sodita v zasnovo. Jarek je hrbtenica. Prepust je njegovo novo grlo. Podporna dela se morajo priključiti nanj, ne da bi si ga lastila.
Do zore si prvi in tretji ne nista več nasprotovala. Drugi se je še vedno.

scenes.title: En paket
paragraphs: *Revizijska dvorana ministrstva · 2. dan, 09:00*
Venn jim je dal devetdeset minut. Zakon o izrednih razmerah je sprostil denar za en paket, enega odgovornega integratorja in en prevzemni preizkus.

**Direktor Miro Venn**  
Branim podpis, zaradi katerega lahko nekoga preganjam, če bo bolnišnica zasuta. Dajte mi eno grlo, ki ga lahko primem.

**Adaeze**  
Okrožja zavračajo, da bi postala najemniki rešitve, ne pa odgovornosti.

Illuminara je na mizo položila štiri strani. Določale so vmesnike, ne zidu: tlak, oddan skupni hrbtenici, izključitev sider okoli grobov, odprte senzorje, ročna varna stanja, javne ključe in skupni pregled vsakega spoja.

**Illuminara**  
Kupite en revidiran vmesnik. Naj tri okrožja izberejo tri skladne module. Integrator je odgovoren za spoje in preizkus, ne za njihov nadzor.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Od kod si dobila osem odstotkov?
Illuminara je list poskusne obremenitve obcestnega grla položila poleg sledi posedanja. Izmerjena rezerva je po tem, ko je slaba podlaga vzela svoj delež, znašala šestnajst odstotkov.

**Illuminara**  
Noben spoj ne sme porabiti več kot polovice najmanjše pasivne rezerve. Povezovalni zatič je ocenjen tako, da pri prenosu nad osmimi odstotki začne lesti in po desetih neprekinjenih minutah poči. Ta vzdržljivost je v kovini, ne v ukazu. Drenažna hrbtenica ob ločitvi ostane odprta.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Potem dobi inšpektor pri vsakem spoju pooblastilo za ustavitev del. Ne nadzorna plošča. Človek.

**Direktor Miro Venn**  
Vsaka napaka in vsak obvod pa morata biti javna pred naslednjo izmeno. Odgovornost ne more živeti v treh zasebnih zvezkih.
Illuminara je prečrtala dve določili in obe spremembi zapisala v standard.

**Illuminara**  
Dogovorjeno. Ni jim treba razmišljati kot en sistem. Odpovedati morajo tako, da zaradi njih ne odpove sosed.
Direktorica bolnišnice Nia Sorel je dvakrat prebrala določilo o vzdržljivosti.

**Nia Sorel**  
Je to mogoče pregledati pred dežjem?

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Če se izkop začne danes in so odločitve dokončne do sončnega zahoda.

Okrožja so izbrala: Kirujski kamniti opornik zunaj grobov; Belujske javne plošče z lokalnimi ključi, ki jih bo upravljal Sami Daro in hranil fizični ključ okrožja; Savska terasasta sidra, povezana z jarkom. Kemijina ekipa bo nadzorovala vsak stari priključek.
Adaeze se je podpisala pod tri zahteve in mesto predsedujoče spojem sprejela samo do dežja. Venn se je podpisal zadnji. En paket je šel v razpis ob 10:27. V njem ni bilo enega samega zidu.

scenes.title: Spoji
paragraphs: *Pobočje Aruwa · 2. do 11. dan*

Najprej so vgradili obcestni prepust. Illuminara je držala izpostavljeno pot obremenitve, medtem ko je ekipa nameščala drugi lok. Izpustila jo je po osemintridesetih minutah, preden bi malta v spoj zaklenila skrito odvisnost; lok je moral pokazati, da se lahko nosi sam. Mensah je ustavil delo, ko je prvi sloj podlage presegel mejo posedanja. Kemijina ekipa ga je zgradila na novo.

Kiru je svoj opornik ukrivil okoli pokopališča. Belu je na feritna rebra namestil dvanajst javnih plošč, vsako s fizičnim ključem. Sava je zabila terasasta sidra in namestila odstranljive zapornice povsod, kjer se je terasa stikala s starim jarkom.

Vsak spoj je potreboval tri podpise: ministrskega inšpektorja, okrožnega operaterja in sosednje ekipe. Med preizkusom šeste plošče je Kemi zaprla spodnjo zapornico. Kazalec prenosa se je dvignil nad osem in se ustavil pri enajstih odstotkih proti Kiruju.

**Glavni inženir Lio Mensah**  
Plošča izpolnjuje lastno specifikacijo. Spoj je ne.

**Sami Daro**  
Zadrži zapornico tam. Spremeni kot, ne odčitka.

Sami je ploščo ponastavil za dve stopinji. Kirujski zidarji so položili žrtveni drsni sloj, medtem ko je Kemi odpirala zapornico z eno zarezo naenkrat. Kazalec je padel na šest odstotkov in se umiril v sedmih minutah. Vse tri ekipe so podpisale napako, preden so podpisale popravilo.
Deveti dan je Cadran ponudil nadzornik neurja brez nadzornega kanala.

**Adaeze**  
Ali ga lahko okrožja izklopijo?

**Sami Daro**  
V naši pisarni. Neobdelani zapisi ostanejo naši.

**Adaeze**  
Potem lahko opazuje. Ne sme postati spomin, ki si ga ne moremo privoščiti izgubiti.

Do 11. dne je prepust prevajal dvakratnik starega največjega pretoka, vsak dnevnik je bil javno dostopen v bolnišnici, vsak modul pa je prestal suho obremenitev. Adaeze je zavrnila ministrsko fotografijo, dokler na njej niso stali Kemi in vsi trije operaterji.

scenes.title: Dež
paragraphs: *Bolnišnica St. Orra in pobočje Aruwa · 12. dan, 03:20 do 18:40*

Dež je prišel tri ure prezgodaj in močnejši od napovedi. Piezometri so se dvignili; devetdeset minut pozneje so se odzvali označevalci pobočja. Voda je pri rdeči hiši vstopila v savski jarek in v rjavi kopreni udarila ob cestni prepust. Grlo je zdržalo.

Ob 06:40 je alarm kirujskega spoja pokazal devet odstotkov proti Beluju. Sami Daro je zmanjšal šesto ploščo, Kemi pa je do vrha tlaka zadržala četrto zapornico. Prenos je ostal nad osemodstotno mejo. Deset neprekinjenih minut je izčrpalo nazivno vzdržljivost zatiča.

Pasivna povezava se je prelomila z zvokom, podobnim poku ročaja lopate. Belu se je od Kiruja ločil natančno tako, kot je zahteval standard. Kirujski opornik je obremenitev nosil sam, njegov žrtveni drsni sloj pa je zdrsnil za pet milimetrov.
Vzhodni kirujski označevalec se je začel premikati: en milimeter, nato dva. Glas Nie Sorel se je oglasil po bolnišničnem kanalu.

**Nia Sorel**  
Pediatrija je pripravljena na izpraznitev. Povejte mi, ali hitrost še narašča.

**Kemi Sol**  
Označevalec se je upočasnil, ko se je odprla četrta zapornica. Še vedno je pri dveh milimetrih.

**Nia Sorel**  
Potem pediatrija ostane. Krilo bom izpraznila, če bo tretji odčitek višji.
Venn je slišal, kako ministrski pravnik sprašuje, kdo bo prevzel odgovornost za evakuacijo, če bo tretji odčitek višji.

**Direktor Miro Venn, po radijski zvezi**  
Cadran lahko zdaj prevzame plošče. Pod odgovornost lahko postavim enega operaterja.

**Sami Daro**  
Potem pod lokalni ključ zapišite moje ime. Belu stoji sam.
Ključ je obrnil v varni kot. Kemi je opazovala, kako beli kamen izginja pod gladino jarka.

**Kemi Sol**  
Četrta zapornica odprta. Terasa zaprta proti jarku. Vse pošljite v prepust.

Tretji odčitek označevalca je ostal pri dveh milimetrih, nato je padel. Štirinajst minut so okrožja nosila ločene obremenitve, prepust pa je prevzemal njihovo skupno vodo. Sami je ploščo ponastavil na štiri odstotke. Zlomljenega zatiča ni bilo mogoče zamenjati pred koncem dežja, zato so moduli ostali ločeni, skupni pregledi pa so se podvojili.
Illuminara je držala radijsko postajo, vendar ni izdala ukaza.

Ob 18:40 je bolnišnica ostala odprta, nihče ni bil evakuiran in noben označevalec pobočja se ni premaknil za več kot štiri milimetre. Kirujski drsni sloj je bil poškodovan, zatiča ni bilo več, skupna rezerva pa bo ostala nedostopna, dokler ne zamenjajo obeh.
Venn je objavil standard s priloženimi sledilnim preizkusom, zavrnjeno podlago, ločitvijo med neurjem in dnevnikom napak.

**Adaeze**  
Trije ne-ji niso postali da.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Postali so oblika tega, kar je bilo mogoče zgraditi.

Adaeze se je dotaknila lica svoje hčere Illuminare in nato odšla navzgor po pobočju vodit pregled. Pri šolskem ovinku je Kemi ob sedmih letih barv narisala oznako najvišje vode. Nova črta je bila najtemnejša in najnižja.

translation_sl.critic_line: En sam eleganten sistem ministrstva je trikrat zavrnjen, vsaka zavrnitev pa postane inženirska zahteva — vaški jarek, prepoznan kot pravi odtok pobočja, standard z zatičem, izdelanim tako, da poči, in ključ, puščen v rokah okrožja — zato bolnišnica ostane odprta na premikajočem se pobočju, ne da bi premaknili en sam grob ali s seboj potegnili soseda.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1: independent GPT and Claude reader appeal; equal model weights (50/50).
shared_strengths: Ticking-clock stakes and a humane, idea-rich conflict—refusals reframed as design requirements, local knowledge vindicated, a system built to fail safely—suit these readers, with crisp aphoristic dialogue and a satisfying climax where breaking is the plan. Dense hydrology jargon, many numbers and names, thin interiority and an unexplained speculative element make the middle hard going for some.

The deadline, Adaeze’s refusals and the shared problem give these readers a reason to keep going. The solution grows from local knowledge and cooperation, making it memorable. Dense engineering detail in the middle may slow some readers, and the ending states its theme rather plainly.
shared_reservations: Venn's turn is compressed. His liability fear meets a document, not an exchange that tests it. His acceptance is implied by one amendment and 'Venn signed last', and his reaction to Sami refusing Cadran control in the storm is skipped. Showing Venn weighing and choosing would deepen dialogue and argument.
Illuminara's care for the threatened residents is expressed chiefly through design decisions. A consequential encounter with a household facing the slope would make that care more immediate.
